race.comment: It looks a lovely bit of placement to see EVAPORATE (2) return to the winner's circle. He's been rock solid for a long time without winning, sent forward in the G2 PB Lawrence Stakes first up when a game third to Cosmic Crusader. 1500m here is perfect and he's pitched in under the conditions. Shinn should tag the lead and prove too strong. PINSTRIPED (7) got home strongly for fourth in the Lawrence, less than a length off EVAPORATE who he meets better off at the weights. The problem for him is the draw - it'll be very hard to give EVAPORATE a lead start and run him down. TEN COMMANDMENTS (12) continues to race very well this time in and is rock hard fit but poorly weighted out of a benchmark 100. FREEDOM RALLY (9) bounced back to form with a good win over this route last time. Has claims off that.
